card.name: Descriptive words about appearance and traits
card.fires_on: Words in general web prose that sit just before a description of a thing's looks, body or physical power, such as 'looks', 'body', 'physically'. Also fires on small verbs or linking words like 'to' and 'be' inside such sentences.

modes.label: Appearance nouns
modes.description: Nouns like looks or body that begin a description of how a creature or object appears.
modes.example: this bridge has the<< looks>> of a beast

modes.label: Physically before adjective
modes.description: The adverb 'physically' placed before an adjective such as imposing or powerful.
modes.example: Fred Soper was a<< physically>> imposing man.

modes.label: Linking words in 'hard to' phrases
modes.description: Small words in phrases about difficulty or ability, like hard to believe or can't help.
modes.example: It is hard<< to>> believe that he identified every fish we saw

card.plain: It fires on words that lead into describing how something looks or how strong it is, in ordinary web writing.
evidence: this bridge has the<< looks>> of a beast
Its<< body>> is dark brown with striae,
Fred Soper was a<< physically>> imposing man.
